decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster is central to the firm's announced coolant-system direction and has stayed visibly on the website since launch, so management will keep backing it and treat any weak results as temporary.
The cleaning centrifuge took substantial engineering investment and rounds out the publicly presented coolant-processing portfolio, which makes persisting with it the justified course.

Scraper belt chip conveyors are a core, high-volume line for a large machinery firm, and dropping the magnetic belt variant already concentrated commitment on the remaining conveyors, so this one is retained.
The hinged belt conveyor is a staple of the chip-handling range that the firm continued to present after pruning, so management will defend it as part of its stated strategy.
